scientific.integrity: The AdamP detector inequality is combined with an exact minimization of the angle between a nonzero vector and its image under an SPD Hessian. The extremal-eigenspace witness attains the bound, so the condition-number frontier is necessary and sufficient.
limitations: Worst-case detector geometry rather than trajectory frequency.
SPD quadratics and one detector group at a time.
No claim about convergence after projection is activated.
Group dimension depends on the channel-wise or layer-wise application.

title: Sharp condition-number frontier for AdamP detector false positives
